description: Use to save a question to the user's library; with `id`, it replaces that saved question. `question` is {text, answer_type: boolean|enum|numeric|date|text|place|list|relation, enum_values?, unit?, relation?, context?, temporal?, spatial?}. Schemas use saved questions (geothought_arrange_schema, geothought_draft_schema). Returns the saved question.
name: geothought_save_question
title: Save a GeoThought question
